purpose: Reassess whether the exact frozen F-GC02 physical coupling trial can be admitted after independent qualification of the explicit Richards head-budget temporal certificate, without introducing a post-hoc application accuracy budget.

exact_frozen_trial.meaning: The 0.01 cm predictor perturbation creates a distinct same-T0 prescribed-head predictor. It is an interface trial perturbation, not a temporal error budget. The legacy transaction temporal_tolerance=0 represented the rejected binary temporal-identity semantics and is not a Richards H_budget.

prohibited_post_hoc_transfers: do not set H_budget equal to the 0.01 cm predictor perturbation
do not reinterpret the old zero temporal identity tolerance as a Richards H_budget
do not use B_inf, 2*B_inf, 0.5*B_inf or any F-VQ34 qualification-only construction as an application budget
do not choose a value after observing the F-GC02 B_inf or acceptance result
do not introduce a coupling or temporal tolerance merely to make the frozen F-GC02 trial pass
do not relax hard mass or interface mass conservation

required_next_work.owner_class: application/runtime coupling policy, not Richards solver physics and not generic transaction acceptance
required_next_work.requirement: Define and independently justify provenance for a finite positive Richards-native head-accuracy budget before any exact F-GC02 re-execution. The numeric requirement must be independent of the frozen F-GC02 B_inf/result and must remain distinguishable from coupling head residual tolerance and predictor perturbation amplitude.
required_next_work.suggested_title: Coupling Head-Accuracy Budget Provenance and Temporal Error Allocation Policy
required_next_work.later_independent_gate: Only after an independently frozen numeric H_budget exists may a fresh F-VQ workunit re-execute the exact frozen F-GC02 physical trial.

invariant_audit.3_explicit_data_separation: PASS: no physical forcing or state value is repurposed as numerical H_budget.
invariant_audit.7_transactional_timesteps: PASS: the previously rejected trial remains rejected; no retrospective commit is allowed.
invariant_audit.11_coupling_core_functionality: PASS: coupling admission remains explicit and fail-closed until numerical accuracy provenance exists.
invariant_audit.13_mass_conservation_absolute: PASS: no mass tolerance or interface residual relaxation is introduced.
invariant_audit.23_physics_solver_policy_separated: PASS: missing numerical policy is not repaired by changing prescribed-head physics.
invariant_audit.26_runtime_diagnostics: PASS: future budget provenance must remain explicit and diagnosable.
invariant_audit.29_no_silent_dependencies: PASS: no hidden/default 0.01 cm or other implicit budget is introduced.
invariant_audit.30_architecture_change_audit: PASS: this reassessment changes evidence/status only and records the unresolved policy dependency explicitly.
